bank.name: Islamic Festivals & Special Days
bank.subject: Islamic Studies
bank.description: The two Eids and other significant days of the Islamic calendar.

questions.prompt: Eid-ul-Fitr is celebrated on which day of Shawwal?
questions.explanation: Eid-ul-Fitr falls on the 1st of Shawwal, marking the end of Ramadan.

questions.prompt: Eid-ul-Adha falls on the 10th of which Islamic month?
questions.explanation: Eid-ul-Adha is on the 10th of Dhul-Hijjah, after the day of Arafat.

questions.prompt: Eid-ul-Adha commemorates the willingness of which prophet to sacrifice his son?
questions.explanation: It commemorates Prophet Ibrahim's (AS) willingness to sacrifice his son in obedience to Allah.

questions.prompt: What is the Takbir recited on Eid days called?
questions.explanation: Takbir-e-Tashreeq is recited after prayers from Eid-ul-Adha's eve through the days of Tashreeq.

questions.prompt: The Prophet Musa (AS) was saved from Pharaoh on which day?
questions.explanation: Musa (AS) and the Israelites were saved on the day of Ashura, for which the Prophet (PBUH) recommended fasting.

questions.prompt: The birthday of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH), 12 Rabi-ul-Awwal, is called?
questions.explanation: 12 Rabi-ul-Awwal is observed as Eid Milad-un-Nabi (the Prophet's birthday).

questions.prompt: The night journey of the Prophet (PBUH) from Makkah to Jerusalem and ascent to the heavens is called?
questions.explanation: Shab-e-Meraj (27 Rajab) marks the Isra (night journey) and Mi'raj (ascension).

questions.prompt: During the Mi'raj, which obligation was prescribed directly by Allah?
questions.explanation: The five daily prayers were ordained during the Mi'raj.

questions.prompt: The night in mid-Sha'ban, when deeds are raised, is called?
questions.explanation: Shab-e-Barat (15 Sha'ban) is observed as a night of forgiveness.

questions.prompt: The Quran says Laylat-ul-Qadr is better than how many months?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Qadr (97:3): 'The Night of Power is better than a thousand months.'

questions.prompt: Which day is celebrated as the 'Day of Arafat'?
questions.explanation: The 9th of Dhul-Hijjah is the Day of Arafat, when pilgrims stand at Arafat; fasting is recommended for others.

questions.prompt: The Islamic New Year begins with which month?
questions.explanation: Muharram is the first month of the Islamic (Hijri) calendar.

questions.prompt: The Hijri calendar year 1 corresponds to which event?
questions.explanation: The Islamic calendar begins with the Hijrah (622 CE) of the Prophet (PBUH) to Madinah.

questions.prompt: Which month is the first of the four sacred months (al-Ashhur al-Hurum)?
questions.explanation: The sacred months are Muharram, Rajab, Dhul-Qa'dah and Dhul-Hijjah.

questions.prompt: How many days does Eid-ul-Fitr last officially?
questions.explanation: Eid-ul-Fitr is one day (1 Shawwal); Eid-ul-Adha's festivities span several days.

questions.prompt: Fasting on which two days is forbidden (except for specific reasons)?
questions.explanation: Fasting on the two Eids is prohibited.

questions.prompt: Which night marks the beginning of Ramadan and the revelation of the Quran?
questions.explanation: Laylat-ul-Qadr, in the last ten nights of Ramadan, marks when the Quran was first revealed.

questions.prompt: Which prayer is offered on the two Eids?
questions.explanation: The Eid prayer has extra Takbirat and is followed by the Khutbah.

questions.prompt: Eid-ul-Adha is also called?
questions.explanation: Eid-ul-Adha is known as the Greater Eid in many Muslim regions.

questions.prompt: What is the Sunnah act of saying 'Takbir' on the days of Eid?
options: Reciting 'Allahu Akbar' aloud, especially from Eid eve to Arafat
questions.explanation: Takbirat are recited from the eve of Eid-ul-Adha through the days of Tashreeq.

questions.prompt: The night before Eid-ul-Fitr is traditionally observed with?
options: Worship and supplication (it is a blessed night)
questions.explanation: The eve of Eid is considered blessed for worship and dua.

questions.prompt: Which month's fasting is most recommended after Ramadan?
questions.explanation: The Prophet (PBUH) said the best fast after Ramadan is in Allah's month, Muharram.

questions.prompt: Which two nights are considered especially significant for worship in Ramadan?
options: The odd nights of the last ten days
questions.explanation: Laylat-ul-Qadr is sought in the odd nights of the final ten days of Ramadan.

questions.prompt: Which day is celebrated as the 'Day of Arafat' with fasting recommended?
questions.explanation: Fasting the Day of Arafat expiates sins of the past and coming year.

questions.prompt: The 10th of Muharram (Ashura) fasting expiates?
options: The sins of the previous year
questions.explanation: The Prophet (PBUH) said fasting Ashura expiates the previous year's sins.

questions.prompt: What is 'Eid-e-Milad-un-Nabi'?
options: The observance of the Prophet's (PBUH) birthday on 12 Rabi-ul-Awwal
questions.explanation: 12 Rabi-ul-Awwal marks the birth of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH).

questions.prompt: Which of the following is the recommended way to celebrate the two Eids?
options: Prayer, takbir, charity and family bonds
questions.explanation: Eid is celebrated with prayer, takbir, charity (Fitr/Adha) and strengthening family ties.

questions.prompt: Which act is recommended on the morning of Eid before the prayer?
options: Taking a bath (Ghusl) and wearing best clothes
questions.explanation: Ghusl, perfume and best attire are Sunnah for both Eid prayers.

questions.prompt: On Eid-ul-Fitr, the Sunnah is to eat something before the prayer; on Eid-ul-Adha, to eat after?
questions.explanation: On Fitr one eats before prayer; on Adha one eats from the sacrifice after prayer.

questions.prompt: How many Takbirat are in the first rakah of the Eid prayer in Hanafi fiqh?
questions.explanation: Hanafi fiqh adds three Takbirat in the first rakah and three in the second.

questions.prompt: How much is the standard Sadaqat-ul-Fitr amount?
options: One Sa' of staple food per person
questions.explanation: Sadaqat-ul-Fitr is a Sa' (about 2.5-3 kg) of staple food per person.

questions.prompt: The Quran mentions the two Eids in which context?
options: Eid is mentioned indirectly; the days are established by Sunnah
questions.explanation: The Quran mentions the festive days indirectly (e.g., 5:114); the Eids are fixed by the Sunnah.

questions.prompt: Which day marks the end of the Hajj and the celebration of Eid-ul-Adha?
questions.explanation: 10 Dhul-Hijjah is Eid-ul-Adha, following the Day of Arafat.

questions.prompt: What is the duration of the Qurbani (sacrifice) days?
questions.explanation: The sacrifice may be performed on the 10th and the two days of Tashreeq.

questions.prompt: The meat of the Qurbani is to be divided into how many parts?
options: Three: for self, relatives and the needy
questions.explanation: Sunnah is to divide the sacrifice among family, relatives and the poor.

questions.prompt: What is the Sunnah number of Takbirs in the Eid prayer?
options: Extra Takbirs (6 additional in Hanafi practice)
questions.explanation: Hanafi fiqh includes extra Takbirs in Eid prayer.

questions.prompt: What is the animal sacrifice on Eid-ul-Adha called?
questions.explanation: Udhiyah/Qurbani is the Eid-ul-Adha sacrifice.

questions.prompt: Which festival is celebrated after the month of fasting?
questions.explanation: Eid-ul-Fitr marks the end of Ramadan.

questions.prompt: The Eid-ul-Fitr prayer is offered:
questions.explanation: Eid prayer is performed in congregation.

questions.prompt: Which occasion is commemorated on 12 Rabi-ul-Awwal?
questions.explanation: Mawlid is observed on 12 Rabi-ul-Awwal.

questions.prompt: Shab-e-Miraj commemorates:
options: The Night Journey to the heavens
questions.explanation: Miraj is the Prophet's (PBUH) ascension.

questions.prompt: On which Islamic date is Shab-e-Miraj observed?
questions.explanation: Miraj is remembered on 27 Rajab.

questions.prompt: Which night is called the 'Night of Forgiveness'?
questions.explanation: Shab-e-Barat is the Night of Forgiveness.

questions.prompt: The 'Night of Power' is better than:
questions.explanation: Lailat-ul-Qadr is better than a thousand months.

questions.prompt: Which festival involves standing at Arafah?
questions.explanation: The Day of Arafah is part of Hajj.

questions.prompt: Which voluntary fast is recommended on the 9th of Dhul-Hijjah?
questions.explanation: Fasting on Arafah expiates the past and coming year.

questions.prompt: The 'Eid prayer' is considered which ruling in the Hanafi school?
questions.explanation: Hanafi scholars deem Eid prayer Wajib.

questions.prompt: The 'Takbir-e-Tashreeq' is recited after which prayer?
questions.explanation: Takbir-e-Tashreeq follows fard prayers on Eid days.

questions.prompt: On which day is fasting forbidden?
questions.explanation: Fasting is prohibited on both Eids.

questions.prompt: Which festival is linked to the story of Ibrahim (AS) and Ismail (AS)?
questions.explanation: Eid-ul-Adha commemorates Ibrahim's sacrifice.

questions.prompt: Lailat-ul-Qadr is sought especially in which nights?
options: The last ten nights of Ramadan
questions.explanation: It lies in the last ten nights, especially odd ones.

questions.prompt: Which act is performed on the 10th Dhul-Hijjah besides the Eid prayer?
questions.explanation: Qurbani is performed on Eid-ul-Adha.

questions.prompt: The 'Khutbah' after Eid prayer is delivered by:
questions.explanation: The Eid khutbah follows the prayer.

questions.prompt: Ashura falls on which date?
questions.explanation: Ashura is the 10th of Muharram.

questions.prompt: Which occasion marks the end of Hajj?
questions.explanation: Eid-ul-Adha coincides with the completion of Hajj rites.

questions.prompt: In which month is the festival of the 'white days' (Ayyam al-Beed) fasting recommended?
questions.explanation: Fasting the white days is recommended each month.

questions.prompt: Eid-ul-Fitr is also called the?
questions.explanation: Eid-ul-Fitr is known as the Smaller Eid, while Eid-ul-Adha is the Greater Eid.

questions.prompt: In the Hanafi school, the second rakah of the Eid prayer has how many extra takbirs?
questions.explanation: In Hanafi fiqh, the second rakah of the Eid prayer has two extra takbirs.

questions.prompt: A goat for Qurbani may be offered on behalf of?
questions.explanation: The Qurbani of a goat or sheep is for one person (or one household).

questions.prompt: A cow or camel Qurbani may be shared among up to how many people?
questions.explanation: A cow or camel may be shared among up to seven people.

questions.prompt: A goat offered for Qurbani must be at least how old?
questions.explanation: A goat must be at least one year old for a valid Qurbani.

questions.prompt: What is 'Eid-e-Ghadeer'?
options: An observance on 18 Dhul-Hijjah recalling the Prophet's (PBUH) address at Ghadir Khumm
questions.explanation: Eid-e-Ghadeer marks 18 Dhul-Hijjah, the day of the Prophet's (PBUH) address at Ghadir Khumm.

questions.prompt: The recommended supplication on Laylat-ul-Qadr is?
questions.explanation: Aisha (RA) was taught to say 'O Allah, You are Forgiving, love forgiveness, so forgive me'.

questions.prompt: The 10th of Muharram is significant because of?
options: The martyrdom of Imam Hussain (RA) and the saving of Musa (AS)
questions.explanation: Ashura recalls Musa's (AS) deliverance and the martyrdom of Hussain (RA) at Karbala.

questions.prompt: The Eid prayer is traditionally performed at?
questions.explanation: The Sunnah is to pray the Eid prayer in an open prayer ground.

questions.prompt: The Takbir-e-Tashreeq is recited until which time?
questions.explanation: Takbir-e-Tashreeq runs from the Fajr of 9 Dhul-Hijjah to the Asr of the 13th.

questions.prompt: Which day is called the 'Day of the Greater Hajj' (Yawm al-Hajj al-Akbar)?
questions.explanation: The 10th of Dhul-Hijjah, the day of sacrifice, is the Day of the Greater Hajj.

questions.prompt: The first ten days of Ramadan are associated with?
questions.explanation: The first Ashra of Ramadan is the days of mercy.

questions.prompt: The middle ten days of Ramadan are associated with?
questions.explanation: The second Ashra is the days of forgiveness.

questions.prompt: The last ten days of Ramadan are associated with?
questions.explanation: The final Ashra of Ramadan is the days of seeking freedom from the Fire.

questions.prompt: Fasting during the first nine days of Dhul-Hijjah is?
questions.explanation: Fasting the first nine days of Dhul-Hijjah is strongly recommended, especially Arafah.

questions.prompt: In the Shafi'i school, the Eid prayer is?
questions.explanation: In the Shafi'i school the Eid prayer is an emphasised Sunnah.

questions.prompt: Which surahs did the Prophet (PBUH) often recite in the two Eid prayers?
questions.explanation: In the Eid prayers the Prophet (PBUH) recited Surah Al-A'la and Surah Al-Ghashiyah.

questions.prompt: Which of the following animals is valid for Qurbani?
questions.explanation: Qurbani is valid with goats, sheep, cows or camels.

questions.prompt: A cow offered for Qurbani must be at least how old?
questions.explanation: A cow must be at least two years old for Qurbani.

questions.prompt: The first Eid-ul-Fitr was celebrated in which year?
questions.explanation: The first Eid-ul-Fitr followed the first Ramadan of obligatory fasting in 2 AH.

questions.prompt: In South Asia, Eid-ul-Adha is commonly called?
questions.explanation: Eid-ul-Adha is popularly called Bakra Eid in South Asia.

questions.prompt: In Pakistan, Eid-ul-Fitr is commonly known as?
questions.explanation: Eid-ul-Fitr is called Meethi Eid in Pakistan because of its sweet dishes.

questions.prompt: The Prophet (PBUH) used to return from the Eid prayer by?
options: A different route from the one he took
questions.explanation: The Sunnah is to return from the Eid prayer by a different path.

questions.prompt: Eid-ul-Adha celebrations extend over how many days?
questions.explanation: Eid-ul-Adha spans the three days of Tashriq.

questions.prompt: The word 'Fitr' in Eid-ul-Fitr means?
questions.explanation: Fitr refers to breaking the fast of Ramadan.

questions.prompt: The word 'Adha' in Eid-ul-Adha is related to?
questions.explanation: Adha comes from Udhiyah, the sacrifice of the day.

questions.prompt: The Eid prayer is performed at what time?
questions.explanation: The Eid prayer is offered after sunrise up to the time of zawal.

questions.prompt: The two Eids are described in hadith as?
options: Days of eating, drinking and remembrance of Allah
questions.explanation: The Prophet (PBUH) called the Eids days of eating, drinking and dhikr.

questions.prompt: Which night is called the 'Night of Bara'ah' (freedom from the Fire)?
questions.explanation: Shab-e-Barat, the 15th of Sha'ban, is the night of freedom from the Fire.

questions.prompt: Which day marks the end of the Hajj season with the sacrifice?
questions.explanation: The 10th of Dhul-Hijjah closes Hajj with Eid-ul-Adha and Qurbani.

questions.prompt: The night of Arafah is the night before which day?
questions.explanation: The night of 9 Dhul-Hijjah precedes Eid-ul-Adha.

questions.prompt: On Eid-ul-Fitr, which charity is given before the prayer?
questions.explanation: Zakat-ul-Fitr is given before the Eid-ul-Fitr prayer.

questions.prompt: Which day is the fast of Arafah observed?
questions.explanation: The fast of Arafah is on the 9th of Dhul-Hijjah for non-pilgrims.

questions.prompt: Which night of Ramadan is called the 'Night of Power'?
questions.explanation: Laylat-ul-Qadr, in the last ten nights, is the Night of Power.

questions.prompt: What is the 'Takbir' that is recited from the eve of Eid-ul-Adha?
options: Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, La ilaha illallah, Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, wa lillahil-hamd
questions.explanation: The Takbir of the Eids glorifies Allah after the obligatory prayers.

questions.prompt: Which festival involves the 'Umrah of Ramadan' being considered equal to Hajj?
questions.explanation: A hadith says Umrah in Ramadan equals Hajj in reward.

questions.prompt: The days of 'Tashriq' fall in which month?
questions.explanation: The 11th-13th of Dhul-Hijjah are the days of Tashriq.

questions.prompt: What is the reward of fasting on the Day of Arafah?
options: Expiates the sins of two years
questions.explanation: Fasting Arafah expiates the sins of the previous and coming year.

questions.prompt: Which companion taught the supplication of Laylat-ul-Qadr to Aisha (RA)?
questions.explanation: The Prophet (PBUH) taught Aisha (RA) the 'afuww' supplication for Laylat-ul-Qadr.

questions.prompt: On which day do Muslims celebrate by offering the 'Udhiyah'?
questions.explanation: The Udhiyah (Qurbani) is offered on 10 Dhul-Hijjah and the days of Tashriq.

questions.prompt: Which night is the 27th of Rajab?
questions.explanation: The 27th of Rajab commemorates the Night Journey and Ascension.

questions.prompt: How many extra takbirs are there in the first rakah of the Eid prayer in Hanafi fiqh?
questions.explanation: In the Hanafi school the first rakah has three extra takbirs.

questions.prompt: The 8th of Dhul-Hijjah, when pilgrims set out to Mina and water the animals, is called?
questions.explanation: The 8th of Dhul-Hijjah is Yawm al-Tarwiyah, the day pilgrims travel to Mina.

questions.prompt: The last Friday of Ramadan, specially honoured in South Asia, is known as?
questions.explanation: Jumu'ah al-Wida, the farewell Friday of Ramadan, is observed with special devotion.
